title: Fahrenheit to Celsius Converter: °F to °C, °C to °F & Kelvin
description: Free Fahrenheit to Celsius converter. Enter a temperature in °F, °C or Kelvin and get the other scales instantly, with the exact formulas and a reference table.
lead: What is 98.6 °F in Celsius? Is 350 °F the same as 176.7 °C? Enter a temperature, pick its unit and see the other two scales at once, along with the exact formula behind the answer.
